q2: SELECT EMAIL FROM (SELECT COUNT(EMAIL) AS C,EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS E WHERE E.C>1

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL FROM (SELECT COUNT(EMAIL) AS C,EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) AS E WHERE E.C>1
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 groups by EMAIL and then filters for emails with a count greater than 1, which can lead to duplicate emails in the result if the same email appears more than once in the PERSON table. Q2, on the other hand, first counts the occurrences of each email and then filters for those counts greater than 1, which avoids the duplication issue by not grouping by EMAIL in the subquery.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when an email appears more than once in the PERSON table. In this case, Q1 will return the email multiple times, while Q2 will return it only once.
